courses.title: Parametric Mounting Bracket
courses.objective: Create a fully editable bracket with holes, pocket, fillets and chamfers

steps.title: Create base sketch
instructions: Sketch an 80 x 50 centered rectangle on XY.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Constrain and dimension
instructions: Apply horizontal, vertical, symmetry and 80/50 mm dimensions.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Extrude base
instructions: Extrude the profile 8 mm.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Create upright sketch
instructions: Sketch a centered 50 x 45 upright profile on the rear face.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Extrude upright
instructions: Extrude the upright 8 mm and join.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.

checkpoint.expected: Base and upright form one body.

steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Add mounting holes
instructions: Place two diameter 8 mm through holes, symmetric about center.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Cut center pocket
instructions: Create a centered 34 x 24 mm through pocket.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.

checkpoint.expected: Pocket is cut through the upright.

steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Finish edges
instructions: Apply 4 mm internal fillets and 1 mm edge chamfers.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

courses.title: Stepped Shaft with Keyway
courses.objective: Build a revolved shaft with editable diameters and keyway

steps.title: Sketch half profile
instructions: Create a half-profile with a construction centerline.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.

checkpoint.expected: Profile is closed and does not cross the axis.

steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Dimension steps
instructions: Set diameters 20/30/40 mm and lengths 30/45/25 mm.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Revolve shaft
instructions: Revolve 360 degrees around the centerline.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Cut keyway
instructions: Cut a 10 x 4 mm keyway along the 30 mm section.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Finish shoulders
instructions: Add 2 mm shoulder fillets and 1 mm end chamfers.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

courses.title: Multi-Body Boolean Workflow

steps.title: Create target
instructions: Create an 80 x 60 x 30 mm target box.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Create round tool
instructions: Create a diameter 30 mm cylinder crossing the box.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Subtract
instructions: Subtract the cylinder from the box.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Create union tool
instructions: Create a 30 x 20 x 20 mm overlapping boss.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Union
instructions: Union boss and target.

steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.

steps.title: Test intersection
instructions: Duplicate bodies and retain their common volume.
steps.why: This establishes the next editable feature.
steps.recovery: Check selection, dimensions and feature order, then retry.
